author: Goldkelch
body:
Repository verification failed when bare Git fixtures were configured from their working directory and when fixture commits inherited runner-level GPG signing settings.

- **Bare repositories:** Bind configuration and symbolic-ref operations explicitly with `--git-dir`.
- **Fixture commits:** Disable signing for isolated test commits.
- **Integrity:** Refresh repository integrity metadata for the modified tests.

```python
run_git(root, "--git-dir", str(remote), "config", "gc.auto", "0")
run_git(root, "--git-dir", str(remote), "symbolic-ref", "HEAD", "refs/heads/main")
```
